finalText:
**The pricing code is wrong, not the tests.**

`computeTotal` rounds to cents right after the percent coupon, then again after the flat one. It converts to the order currency and rounds a third time. The rule is round once, at the end.

Each early round drops a fraction of a cent. The currency rate then multiplies that gap up past half a cent, so the total lands one cent low.

10 of 40 tests fail, all of them with `SAVE10PCT`. `USD` and `EUR` pass by luck — their gap never crosses the rounding line, which is why most carts look fine.

The fix is `engine.js` lines 24 and 27: keep the full precision and drop both `round(..., 2)` calls. I ran that version against all 40 cases and got no mismatches. I have not changed the file.
